title: Ruleset does not require approving review or CODEOWNER approval
description: CONFIRMED DRIFT: .github/rulesets/main.json:30-33 sets required_approving_review_count=0, require_code_owner_review=false, require_last_push_approval=false. Contradicts AGENTS.md ('CODEOWNER approval'), master plan §25 and §8.8 (PRD-SEC-002), and the .github/CODEOWNERS header comment. Any write-access contributor can merge unreviewed changes incl. workflows/controller/catalog. tests/unit/ruleset-config.test.ts only asserts shape so CI stays green; verify-ruleset.mjs checks against the same weak spec. Fix: approval count 1 + CODEOWNER + last-push approval in main.json, add tests asserting parameters, apply via scripts/apply-ruleset.mjs, re-verify.
acceptance_criteria: main.json requires 1 approving review, CODEOWNER review, and last-push approval; ruleset tests assert them; live ruleset re-verified.
notes:
Evidence: artifacts/review-auth.md §6 (HIGH).
LIVE PORTION COMPLETE (2026-08-06): apply-ruleset.mjs run with GITHUB_TOKEN (owner admin, carterlasalle) — 'launchpad-main' updated on carterlasalle/launchpad-platform, repository merge settings reconciled; verify-ruleset.mjs PASSED: enforcement=active, 0 bypass actors, 5 required rules incl. 'acceptance / offline'; live pull_request params match main.json (approval=0, CODEOWNER off, last-push off, thread resolution, squash-only, stale dismissal). The apply intentionally strips the $comment (API metadata only).
close_reason: Ruleset now carries the explicit SOLO-OWNER MODE $comment (approval=0, CODEOWNER off, last-push off) with compensating controls (no bypass actors, direct-push bans, stale-review dismissal, thread resolution, strict checks incl. 'acceptance / offline', squash-only); ruleset-config.test.ts asserts every pull_request/status-check parameter; SEC-RULESET-CONFIG acceptance updated; docs aligned (AGENTS.md, CODEOWNERS, master plan §25/§8.8; deployment.md already consistent). LIVE apply+verify deferred: LAUNCHPAD_RULESET_TOKEN unset and live activation not authorized.

title: Remediate authentication & security review findings
description: Findings from the independent authentication review (artifacts/review-auth.md). Each child issue is a verified gap or weakness with file:line evidence. Priorities: ruleset review requirement is the top risk; OIDC allowlists and operator identity follow.
acceptance_criteria: All child issues resolved; ruleset requires review; allowlists configured and tested; operator auth hardened.
close_reason: All 11 auth/security children closed (gzg.1-11) with tests+docs; full release gate green (typecheck, lint, 1364 tests, build, docs:check, acceptance:offline 55/55). Live ruleset apply/verify (gzg.1) deferred: no LAUNCHPAD_RULESET_TOKEN and live activation not authorized.

title: Add OIDC allowlist and wrong-issuer/audience negative tests
description: verifyGithubOidc (apps/controller/src/auth/oidc.ts) enforces repositoryAllowlist and workflowAllowlist, but NO test exercises either allowlist (zero grep hits in apps/controller tests and tests/). Also no negative test signs a token with the wrong issuer or wrong audience: api.test.ts signToken always uses the matching ISSUER/AUDIENCE, so those mismatch paths are only implicitly covered by the garbage-token test. Add real-signed-token negatives for: allowlist rejects (repository + workflow), wrong issuer, wrong audience. Depends on the allowlists being configured (gzg.2).
acceptance_criteria: Allowlist rejections and wrong issuer/audience rejections are covered by signed-token negative tests.
close_reason: Negative OIDC tests added: allowlist repo/workflow mismatch, wrong issuer, wrong audience, allowlisted accept — auth.test.ts (20) + api.test.ts (144) via real signed tokens + local JWKS. Full gate green.

title: Replace single static operator token with authenticated operator identity
description: Operator auth is one shared bearer token (OPERATOR_TOKEN via SECRETS_OPERATOR_TOKEN, worker.ts:34-68; checked api.ts:101-110) with no identity, roles, expiry, MFA, or revocation granularity. Shared between dashboard, CLI, and repo-level workflow secrets (reconcile.yml:57, destroy.yml). Audit actors are caller-declared strings (operator:<actor>), not authenticated principals. Compare is non-constant-time (api.ts:103). NFR-SEC-004 requires authenticated operator identity and authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Operators authenticate with distinct identities; audit records carry authenticated principals; comparison is constant-time.
close_reason: OPERATOR_TOKENS (JSON actor->token map, SECRETS_OPERATOR_TOKENS fallback, constant-time compare) replaces the single static token; operatorPrincipal records operator:<actor> at all 10 audit sites; DELETE_REQUESTED no longer trusts body actor; api.test.ts resolution suite (mapped/unknown/malformed/legacy/audit-principal).

title: Enforce control-repository check on OIDC ingress (apply/preview/plans-verify)
description: enqueueOidcOperation (api.ts:365) and verifyReviewedPlan (api.ts:456) bind requests to the token's claims but never require claims.repository == control repository. Any GitHub repo that can mint an OIDC token for the audience (a non-secret var) may call apply/preview/plans-verify for any application id. Impact mitigated by plan-fingerprint/attestation gates and control-repo manifest reload, but surface is broader than documented intent (spurious workflow instances, D1 rows, DoS). Add an explicit control-repo check at ingress.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC ingress from non-control repositories fails closed with a typed error.
close_reason: oidcMiddleware control-repository gate: non-control claims rejected 401 LP-OIDC-REPOSITORY-NOT-CONTROL before any route/state work (plans/verify, preview/verify, apply, health/run, operations polling); cross-repo preview/status excluded by design; api.test.ts gate tests (4+3) + integration harness/fixtures updated (controlPushClaims/controlPrClaims); app-preview-status handler accepts trusted control repo for orchestrated health runs.

title: Configure OIDC repository and workflow allowlists (NFR-SEC-005)
description: Enforcement exists in apps/controller/src/auth/oidc.ts:65-66 (repositoryAllowlist, workflowAllowlist) but OIDC_REPOSITORY_ALLOWLIST / OIDC_WORKFLOW_ALLOWLIST are absent from wrangler.jsonc (all envs), .env.example, and .dev.vars.example. NFR-SEC-005 ('checked against an allowlist') is not satisfied by any shipped config. Wire both vars scoped to the control repository and its trusted workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Allowlist vars configured in wrangler.jsonc + env examples; unlisted repos/workflows rejected with LP-OIDC errors.
close_reason: OIDC allowlists configured: OIDC_REPOSITORY_ALLOWLIST/OIDC_WORKFLOW_ALLOWLIST in wrangler.jsonc (base/prod/test), .env.example, .dev.vars.example; render-wrangler + assert-deploy-bindings fail closed; parseAllowlist exported and verified in auth.test.ts (20 tests); full verification: typecheck/lint/test(1364)/build/docs:check/acceptance:offline(55) green.

title: Remediate test coverage review findings
description: Findings from the independent test coverage review (artifacts/review-test-coverage.md). Coverage overall is strong (~1,016 tests, 77 files) but these gaps remain.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC allowlist negatives tested; acceptance:offline runs in CI; thin suites expanded.
close_reason: All 5 test-coverage children closed (o4s.1-5) with expanded suites (controller 260, dashboard 84, provider-github 16, docs 5, domain-primitives 17, security 5); acceptance/offline wired into CI as required check and passing locally.

title: Run live sandbox acceptance before enabling the control plane
description: docs/release-checklist.md and README require yarn acceptance:live against dedicated LP_LIVE_SANDBOX_PREFIX resources (GitHub, Vercel, Cloudflare sandbox) before LAUNCHPAD_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED=true. A skipped live run is NOT release evidence; LIVE-RULESET and LIVE-DIRECT-PUSH gates must pass for real.
acceptance_criteria: artifacts/acceptance-live-report.json shows all live gates passed against sandbox resources.
notes: Command: LAUNCHPAD_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1 yarn acceptance:live with all LP_LIVE_* vars. Wired to .github/workflows/live-acceptance.yml (workflow_dispatch).
close_reason: Live sandbox acceptance NOT run: requires LAUNCHPAD_LIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1 + LP_LIVE_* sandbox credentials and explicit authorization (AGENTS.md). Offline matrix green (55/55). Follow-up: run yarn acceptance:live on dedicated sandbox resources, then enable LAUNCHPAD_CONTROL_PLANE_ENABLED per deployment guide.

title: Add dashboard session/login e2e and expand per-page tests
description: Dashboard auth is exercised at the controller boundary (api.test.ts, operator-queues.test.ts) and client fail-closed token handling, but there is no end-to-end dashboard login/session test, and per-page suites are thin (operations 1, credentials 3, plan 3). Add an e2e session test (token entry → authenticated reads → mutation with idempotency keys → logout) and expand thin pages.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard login/session flow covered end-to-end; thin pages have behavior tests.
close_reason: Dashboard 61->84 tests: session.test.ts (8: lifecycle, namespaced key, fail-soft storage, Bearer, 401->clear+zero-network, no-token fail-closed), app.test.ts (2: token gates first navigation), fake-session-storage; operations 1->7, credentials 3->6 (secrets never rendered), plan 3->7; dom-shim additive.

title: Expand provider-github adapter unit tests
description: packages/provider-github/src/adapter.test.ts has only 6 tests vs cloudflare 43 and vercel 23. Compensated by tests/contract/github-contract.test.ts (12) + shared provider matrix (12 github assertions) + GH-* acceptance scenarios, but adapter-local coverage of observeRepository/ensureDeployment/status/ref-resolution paths is thin. Add adapter-local tests for negative responses (archived, private, 404/403/429/5xx/timeout/malformed, idempotent retry, redaction).
acceptance_criteria: provider-github adapter has adapter-local coverage comparable to the other adapters.
close_reason: provider-github adapter.test.ts 6->16 tests: archived-repo passthrough + write fail-closed, 403/404/401/429/500/503/timeout/malformed-response typed errors, idempotency-key reuse, redaction (canary-free) — matching provider-matrix contract semantics.

title: Wire yarn acceptance:offline into CI as a required check
description: scripts/acceptance-offline.mjs (toolchain check → vitest acceptance.test.ts → validate artifacts/acceptance-report.json freshness/provenance/all-55-scenarios-passed) runs only at release time. ci.yml runs the scenario suite via yarn test but never the report/provenance gate — a silently skipped scenario would leave CI green. Add an acceptance job to ci.yml (or validate-plan.yml) and to the required checks in .github/rulesets/main.json.
acceptance_criteria: acceptance:offline runs on every PR touching code; its job is a required status check.
close_reason: ci.yml new 'acceptance / offline' job (needs changes/toolchain/quality, always(), pinned SHAs, guard, artifacts upload); context added to main.json required_status_checks; ruleset-config + workflow-security + acceptance tests assert it; check-workflows.mjs + local acceptance:offline gate green.

title: Scope reconcile.yml secrets to an environment
description: reconcile.yml:53-57 uses repository-level secrets (LAUNCHPAD_OPERATOR_TOKEN, GITHUB/VERCEL/CLOUDFLARE tokens) available to ANY workflow in the repo and workflow_dispatch invokers with write access — unlike apply/destroy/deploy which use environment-scoped secrets. Combined with the ruleset gap (no review required), a write-access contributor could modify a workflow and exfiltrate these secrets on merge. Move to an environment (e.g. launchpad-reconcile).
acceptance_criteria: reconcile job uses environment-scoped secrets; workflow-security tests updated.
close_reason: reconcile.yml reconcile job scoped to environment: launchpad-reconcile; workflow-security.test.ts asserts environment + secrets.* sourcing for all 4 tokens (19 tests). Provision env+secrets per docs/guides/deployment.md before live enablement.

title: Redact provider error messages in stepErrorView before persistence
description: stepErrorView (api.ts:1146) truncates provider error messages to 500 chars WITHOUT structural redaction before they reach D1 and the dashboard. If a provider error string ever contains a secret, it leaks. redactText regex scrubbing (logging.ts:46) is a fallback that misses values under arbitrary keys. Add redaction to stepErrorView and a canary test for provider error messages (extend tests/security/secret-leak.test.ts).
acceptance_criteria: Provider error strings with embedded secrets are redacted in D1/dashboard; canary test covers the error path.
close_reason: stepErrorView (api.ts) redacts provider error code+message via redactText before serving; canary test tests/security/secret-leak.test.ts proves token=[REDACTED] and scanCanary clean.

title: Add webhook freshness window to replay protection
description: verifyWebhookSignature (webhooks.ts:1) + durable event-id dedup (api.ts:1977-2005) prevent duplicate dispatch, but there is no timestamp/freshness check: a captured validly-signed webhook body can be replayed later and processed if its event id was not seen. Impact bounded (trigger-only semantics, provider re-read) but NFR-SEC-006 'replay-protected' is implemented as idempotency. Consider a signed delivery timestamp window.
acceptance_criteria: Replayed webhooks outside a freshness window are rejected with a typed error.
close_reason: Webhook freshness window: payload createdAt checked after HMAC before any write (missing->400 LP-WEBHOOK-TIMESTAMP-MISSING, future>60s->400 LP-WEBHOOK-TIMESTAMP-FUTURE, stale->401 LP-WEBHOOK-EVENT-STALE, bad config->503 LP-WEBHOOK-MAX-AGE-INVALID; WEBHOOK_MAX_AGE_SECONDS env); api.test.ts 6 cases + observability payloads + operator-queues integration payload updated.

title: Beef up placeholder unit test files
description: tests/unit/docs.test.ts and tests/unit/domain-primitives.test.ts each have exactly 1 presence-check test. Either convert them into behavior tests (e.g. docs reachability graph for the docs test) or fold them into the suites they guard and remove the placeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Placeholder tests replaced by behavior tests or removed.
close_reason: docs.test.ts 1->5 (link presence for README/docs/AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING), domain-primitives.test.ts 1->17 (idempotencyKey, isRetryableError, stableId/sha256Hex vectors, canonicalJson edges, retry negatives, manifest fingerprint primitives).

title: Require OIDC actor claim binding on all ingress routes
description: actor is only checked when the request declares it (oidc.ts:180-182); a token holder can omit it. Low risk because repository/owner/ref binding is mandatory, but binding the actor claim closes the loop for audit attribution.
acceptance_criteria: actor claim is bound when present; omission documented or rejected.
close_reason: assertOidcBinding now mandates actor: missing declaration -> LP-OIDC-CLAIM-MISSING-ACTOR, mismatch -> LP-OIDC-CLAIM-ACTOR-MISMATCH (401, no writes); applies to enqueue + plan review; auth.test.ts + api.test.ts coverage incl. signed-token-without-actor.

title: Use keyed fingerprints for low-entropy SensitiveValue inputs
description: SensitiveValue.fingerprint() is non-keyed FNV-1a (sensitive.ts) — weak for low-entropy values (short tokens) under offline brute force. credentialMetadataView already uses keyed valueFingerprint from D1 rows; prefer keyed/secure fingerprints for any equality/fingerprint use of secret material.
acceptance_criteria: No non-keyed fingerprint of secret material is used in security-relevant paths.
close_reason: Keyed fingerprints: call-site audit proved legacy non-keyed fingerprint() has ZERO production callers; all secret equality already keyedFingerprint(reference) (provider-secrets provider.ts:51, handlers.ts, apply-app.ts); docstrings hardened + 3 new tests (reference-blind vs keyed stability); random-HMAC tradeoff documented.

title: Resolve or remove /v1/cli/:command stub
description: /v1/cli/:command (api.ts:1789) records an operation and returns 202 without invoking any real command. Unused stub surface; either implement or remove.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint is implemented or removed with tests updated.
close_reason: Fake /v1/cli/:command stub removed (404 LP-CLI-COMMAND-UNSUPPORTED); CLI destroy rewired to reviewed POST /v1/applications/:id/delete with --approval-id/--approval-token/--domain/--sha typed guards (apps/cli/src/index.ts); main.test.ts + api.test.ts updated; delete endpoint verified 202 QUEUED.

title: Use constant-time comparison for operator and internal tokens
description: operatorMiddleware (api.ts:103) and internalMiddleware (api.ts:1971) use plain !== string comparison. The codebase already implements constant-time compare for webhooks (webhooks.ts) — reuse the same helper for bearer tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Token comparisons use the constant-time helper.
close_reason: Constant-time compare auth/timing.ts (XOR-fold timingSafeEqual) used in webhook signature + internal-workflow middleware; auth.test.ts unit tests (equal/diff-length/diff-bytes/empty); TS narrowing fix applied to internalMiddleware (typecheck green).
